Name: Friendship Tweaks Unofficial fix
Author: Kowserkhan
Description:
[size=5][b]Original mod by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/aedenthorn]aedenthorn[/url][/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Main Features[/b][/size]
This mod adds config variables to multiply friendship points gained and lost. By default both multipliers are set to 1, meaning no change. Setting to 2 will double the amount gained or lost, setting to 0.5 will halve it, etc.

The mod also lets you set the maximum hearts an NPC can have, only applicable to spouses. The maximum number of hearts possible is 30 with this mod.

[b]Changes made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Xen0nex]Xen0nex[/url][/b]
[list]
[*]Updated Generic Mod Config Menu integration for better future compatibility[/*]
[*]Now has additional config settings for changing the gift friendship gain multipliers for Birthday & Secret Winter Star gifts (vanilla is 8x & 5x, respectively).[/*]
[*]Also added a new config setting for changing the special gift friendship multiplier
Spoiler:  
[spoiler]Stardrop Tea[/spoiler]
has as a Birthday or Secret Winter Star gift (vanilla is 3x).[/*]
[*]Sets the default config setting for "Max Hearts" to 14, so all default config settings will now match Vanilla.[/*]
[/list][b]Changes added by me[/b]
[list]
[*]Compatibility with all NPC's (except children)[/*]
[*]Social menu patch for proper hearts visual[/*]
[*]max hearts limit is now 30[/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Config[/size][/b]

You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

[b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.
